clips.title: The story
paras: Gnolls prowl Galardell Valley beneath the Tower of Ilgalar in northeastern Redridge. The canyon is a danger to the settlements nearby.

Redridge gnolls prowl Galardell Valley, beyond the reach of Lakeshire's defenders. They roam the lowlands and camp along the canyon floor under brutal pack leaders such as Lieutenant Fangore. Above the ravines rises the Tower of Ilgalar, stronghold of the renegade mage Morganth. The gnolls and the tower keep the valley a source of dread for nearby settlements.
